method: requirements-check-1 (Sonnet 5 judge + Sonnet 5 check; disagreements unknown; quotes verified)

apiKey.keyFor: Both features (interest summary and RSS filtering) call an OpenAI-compatible LLM API

evidence.quote: An OpenAI-compatible API key (OpenAI, or any compatible provider)
Set your API key in Breeze settings
| API Base URL | OpenAI-compatible API endpoint | `https://api.openai.com/v1` |

checkNote: The key is required. The code in breeze.js returns early with a 'no api key' alert when apiKey is empty, and the README says 'An OpenAI-compatible API key'. The apiUrl pref is configurable, but the pack never mentions Ollama, LM Studio or a local endpoint. The quoted default is api.openai.com, which does not support 'yes', so 'unknown' is the honest answer.
